title: 16-Day Mediterranean Discovery: Egypt, Greece & Turkey
metaDescription: Journey from Cairo to Santorini, Mykonos, Athens, Istanbul and Cappadocia in 16 days, combining ancient wonders, Greek islands and Turkish landscapes.

summary:
The 16-Day Egypt, Greece & Turkey Tour unfolds in three distinct stages, beginning with Egypt before moving through the Aegean and finishing across Turkey. Start in Cairo, then travel south for Aswan, a three-night Nile cruise and Luxor. Santorini and Mykonos introduce the island section before Athens completes the Greek portion. In Turkey, the route continues through Istanbul and Cappadocia before turning west to ancient Ephesus and the travertine terraces of Pamukkale.
Travel is planned between April and October around seasonal connections. Selected hotels, the 3-night Nile cruise, breakfast and specified meals, professional local guides, domestic flights, Greek ferries, airport transfers, entrance fees and scheduled sightseeing are included.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Cairo
itinerary.text:
Arrival at Cairo International Airport. Meet our representative for assistance and transfer to your hotel in Cairo.
The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Tour to Pyramids Memphis & Sakkara
itinerary.text: Meet your guide and visit Memphis, the ancient capital of Egypt, and see the impressive statue of Ramesses II. Continue to Saqqara to explore the famous Pyramid of Djoser. Afterwards, visit the legendary Giza pyramid complex and admire the iconic Great Sphinx of Giza. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Visit Egyptian Museum & Citadel
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel in Cairo. Visit the impressive Grand Egyptian Museum and the historic Cairo Citadel, including the beautiful Mosque of Muhammad Ali. Continue to explore Old Cairo with visits to the The Hanging Church and Saints Sergius and Bacchus Church (Abu Serga Church). End the day at the famous Khan el-Khalili Bazaar. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Day Trip to Alexandria
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel and drive to Alexandria. Visit the famous Bibliotheca Alexandrina before lunch. In the afternoon, explore the ancient Roman Amphitheatre, continue to Pompey's Pillar, and see the historic Citadel of Qaitbay from outside. Drive back to Cairo for overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Cairo to Athens By Flight
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel in Cairo. Check out and transfer to Cairo International Airport for your flight to Athens.
Upon arrival, meet and transfer to your hotel. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Half day Athens Tour
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel in Athens. Enjoy a half-day city tour including the famous Acropolis of Athens, the iconic Parthenon, and the modern Acropolis Museum. Continue with panoramic highlights of Athens before returning to the hotel. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Athens to Mykonos By Ferry
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel in Athens. Transfer to the port for your ferry to Mykonos.
Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel and enjoy free time at leisure. Overnight in Mykonos.

itinerary.title: Free day in Mykonos
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel in Mykonos. Full day at leisure to explore the island, relax on its beautiful beaches, or wander through the charming streets of Mykonos Town. In the evening, enjoy Mykonos’ famous nightlife and lively atmosphere. Overnight in Mykonos.

itinerary.title: Mykonos to Santorin By Ferry
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel in Mykonos. Transfer to the port for your ferry to Santorini.
Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel and enjoy free time at leisure. Overnight in Santorini.

itinerary.title: Free day in Santorini
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel in Santorini. Enjoy a free day at leisure to relax and explore the island at your own pace. Visit the charming town of Fira, enjoy Santorini’s famous volcanic beaches, or take optional boat and sightseeing tours around the island and volcano. Spend the evening enjoying the beautiful caldera views and atmosphere of Santorini. Overnight in Santorini.

itinerary.title: Santorini to Istanbul via Athens By Flight
itinerary.text:
Breakfast. Check out and free time until transfer to the airport for your flight to Istanbul via Athens.
Upon arrival, meet and transfer to your hotel. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul Oldcity Walking Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, enjoy a guided tour of Istanbul. Visit the historic Hippodrome of Constantinople, including the Egyptian Obelisk, Serpentine Column, and Fountain of Wilhelm II. Continue to the iconic Blue Mosque and the magnificent Hagia Sophia. After lunch, explore the atmospheric Basilica Cistern, famous for its ancient columns and underground beauty. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Bosphorus cruise – Flight to Cappadocia
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, visit the historic Spice Bazaar, also known as the Egyptian Bazaar, famous for its colorful spices, sweets, and local products since 1665. Continue with a memorable Bosphorus cruise, sailing between Europe and Asia along one of the world’s most scenic waterways. After the tour, transfer to the airport at 15:00 for your flight to Nevsehir at 18:45. Upon arrival at 20:10, and transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: North Cappadocia Tour
itinerary.text:
Optional: Early morning hot air balloon ride over Cappadocia.
After breakfast at 10:00, enjoy a full-day tour of North Cappadocia. Visit Uchisar Castle for panoramic views, followed by Rose Valley, Pasabag, and the Zelve Open Air Museum, famous for fairy chimneys and cave dwellings. After lunch, continue to Devrent Valley and Three Beauties, then visit the charming towns of Urgup and Avanos, known for traditional pottery. After the tour, return to the hotel. Overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: South Cappadocia Tour- Flight to Istanbul
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 10:00, enjoy a full-day tour of South Cappadocia. Visit Ortahisar Castle, Mustafapasa, Sobesos Ancient City, and Soganli Valley. After lunch, explore Kaymakli Underground City. Transfer to Kayseri Airport for your flight to Istanbul (19:30–21:00) Arrival and transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Istanbul.

Check-out and transfer to Istanbul Airport for your departure flight

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the Egypt, Greece & Turkey Tour – 16 Days?
faqs.a: This 16-day multi-country journey covers Istanbul and Cappadocia in Turkey; Athens, Mykonos, and Santorini in Greece; and Cairo and Alexandria in Egypt. The itinerary combines ancient history, iconic landmarks, beautiful islands, vibrant cities, and cultural experiences across three fascinating countries. The tour runs for 15 nights and 16 days.

faqs.q: How much does the Egypt, Greece & Turkey Tour – 16 Days cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €3,775 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, guided sightseeing tours, selected meals, airport and hotel transfers, domestic transportation, and four domestic flights. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and hotel category.

faqs.q: Are flights included in the package?
faqs.a: Yes, four domestic flights are included within the itinerary, helping travelers maximize sightseeing time and travel comfortably between destinations. International flights are not included unless specifically stated.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes carefully selected hotels throughout Turkey, Greece, and Egypt. Daily breakfast is included, with additional meals provided according to the itinerary. Accommodations are selected for their comfort, quality, and convenient locations.

Yes, professional English-speaking guides accompany the scheduled sightseeing tours in each country. Your guides will provide expert commentary on the history, archaeology, culture, and traditions of the destinations visited.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Turkey, Greece, and Egypt?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors seeking an excellent introduction to three of the Mediterranean's most popular destinations. It combines cultural landmarks, historical treasures, scenic islands, and memorable local experiences.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites, historic city centers, museums, island towns, and uneven terrain. Most visitors with average fitness levels can comfortably participate.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of the tour?
faqs.a: Highlights include the historic treasures of Istanbul, the fairy chimneys of Cappadocia, the iconic Acropolis in Athens, the beautiful islands of Mykonos and Santorini, the Pyramids of Giza and Egyptian Museum in Cairo, and the rich Greco-Roman heritage of Alexandria on Egypt's Mediterranean coast.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the Egypt, Greece & Turkey Tour – 16 Days?
faqs.a: Free cancellation is available up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms, airline conditions, and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is strongly recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Can the Egypt, Greece & Turkey Tour – 16 Days be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour can be customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights, upgrade hotel categories, include additional destinations, extend your stay in any of the countries, or modify the itinerary to suit your travel interests. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
